ख: ख The second consonant of the Deva Nagari alphabet, being the aspirate of the proceding; it is written in the Roman character Kh.

ख n. (-खं) 	 1. Heaven. 	 2. Sky or ether. 	 3. An organ of sense. 	 4. Know-ledge. 	 5. Happiness, pleasure. 	 6. vacuity. 	 7. A dot, a cypher. 	 8. A city, a field. 	 9. Action. 	 10. Auspiciousness. 	 11. Tale. 	 12. The tenth constellation from any given one, or the sun's entrance in-to it. 	 13. Brahma the supreme spirit. 	 m. (-खः) A name of the sun.  E. खन् to dig, to penetrate, affix ड.
खकुन्तल: खकुन्तल m. (-लः) A name of SIVA.  E. ख ether, कुन्तल hair.
खक्ख: खक्ख r. 1st cl. (-खक् खति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also कख.
खक्खट: खक्खट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, solid: see कक्खट.
खखोल्क: खखोल्क m. (-ल्कः) The sun.  E. ख the sky, and खोल्क a meteor, &c.
खग: खग m. (-गः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. The sun. 	 4. A planet. 	 5. deity. 6. Air, wind. 	 7. A grasshopper.  E. ख the sky, &c. and ग who goes.
खगपति: खगपति m. (-तिः) A name of GARUDA, the bird or vehicle of VISHNU. E. खग a bird. and पति lord or chief.
खगम: खगम m. (-मः) A bird.  E. ख, and गम what goes.
खगवक्त्र: खगवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A tree, commonly Lakucha, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. खग a bird, and वक्त्र face, bird-faced.
खगवती: खगवती f. (-तिः) The earth.  E. खग a bird, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
खगशत्रु: खगशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionitis cordifolia, Rox.)  E. खग a bird, and शत्रु an enemy.
खगस्थान: खगस्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. The hollow of a tree. 	 2. A bird's nest.  E. खग a bird, स्थान place.
खगान्तक: खगान्तक m. (-कः) A hawk, falcon.  E. खग, and अन्तक destroyer.
खगासन: खगासन m. (-नः) 	 1. The eastern mountain over which the sun rises. 	 2. A name of VISHNU.  E. खग a bird or the sun, and आसन seat or place of abiding.
खगेन्द्र: खगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of GARUDA.  E. खग, and इन्द्र chief.
खगेन्द्रध्वज: खगेन्द्रध्वज m. (-जः) VISHNU.  E. खगेन्द्र, and ध्वज emblem.
खगेश्वर: खगेश्वर m. (-रः) GARUDA the bird of VISHNU; also खगेश. K. खग, and ईश्वर king of birds.
खगोड: खगोड m. (-डः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
खगोल: खगोल m. (-लः) 	 1. The vault or circle of the heavens, the planisphere. 	 2. The same represented artificially, the armillary sphere.  E. ख, and गोल sphere.
खगोलविद्या: खगोलविद्या f. (-द्या) Astronomy.  E. खगोल and विद्या knowledge.
खङ्कर: खङ्कर m. (-रः) A curl, a lock of hair.
खच: खच r. 1st cl. (खचति) also r. 9th cl. (खच्नाति) 	 1. To be past birth. 	 2. To cause prosperity. 	 3. To purify. r. 10th cl. (खचयति) To fasten, to bind, to set.
खचमस: खचमस m. (-सः) The moon.  E. ख the sky, चम् to eat, and अस aff.
खचर: खचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Moving in the sky, flying in the air. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. An aerial spirit. 	 3. Air, wind. 	 4. A demon. 	 5. The sun. 	 6. A bird.  E. ख the sky, and चर who goes, from चर् to go, affix ट; see also खेचर.
खचित: खचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Mixed, blended, inlaid. 	 2. Joined, combined. E. खच् to fasten, &c. affix क्त.
खज: खज r. 1st cl. (खजति) To churn or agitate. (इ,) खजि (खञ्जति) To limp, to halt, to walk lame or ill.
खज m. (-जः) A ladle, a spoon. 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. Churning, stirring. 	 2. Killing, destroying. 	 3. The palm with the fingers extended.  E. खज् to agi-tate, &c. affix अच्.
खजक: खजक m. (-कः) The churning stick. 	 f. (-जिका) A ladle or spoon.  E. खज् to churn or agitate, affix. ण्वुल्.
खजप: खजप m. (-पः) Ghee or clarified butter.  E. खज् to stir or agitate, Unadi affix अप.
खजल: खजल n. (-लं) 	 1. Frost, hoar frost. 	 2. Dew, rain.  E. ख the sky, and जल water.
खजाक: खजाक mf. (-कः-का) A spoon, a ladle. 	 m. (-कः) A bird.  E. खज to agitate, and आक Unadi aff.
खजित्: खजित् m. (-जित्) A Buddha, one of the seven teachers or saints of the Buddha sect.  E. ख heaven, and जित् who subdues.
खज्योतिस्: खज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A fire-fly.  E. ख, and ज्योतिस् light.
खञ्ज: खञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Lame, crippled, limping. 	 f. (-ञ्जा) A species of metre, a stanza of two lines, one of thirty-two, the other of thirty feet.  E. खजि to limp or go lame, affix अच्.
खञ्जक: खञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Lame, limping.  E. खजि to limp, affix वुन्.
खञ्जखेट: खञ्जखेट m. (-टः) A wag-tail.  E. खञ्ज lame, and खेट who moves.
खञ्जखेल: खञ्जखेल m. (-लः) A wag-tail.  E. खञ्ज lame, and खेल who moves, from खेल् to move, affix अच्.
खञ्जन: खञ्जन m. (-नः) A small bird, the wag-tail, (Motacilla alba.) 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. A small kind of wag-tail. 	 2. Mustard. 	 n. (-नं) Going, moving. E. खजि to go lamely, affix ल्यु.
खञ्जनरत: खञ्जनरत n. (-तं) The cohabitation of saints.  E. खञ्जन a wag-tail, and रत cohabitation.
खञ्जनाकृति: खञ्जनाकृति f. (-तिः) A sort of wag-tail.
खञ्जनिका: खञ्जनिका f. (-का) A kind of wag-tail.
खञ्जरीट: खञ्जरीट m. (-टः) A wag-tail.  E. खञ्ज lame, ऋ to go, कीटन् affix, deriv. irr.
खट: खट r. 1st cl. (खटति) To desire, to wish, to seek or inquire.

खट m. (-टः) 	 1. Grass. 	 2. Phlegm. the phlegmatic or watery humor. 	 3. A blind well. 	 4. An axe, a hatchet. 	 5. A closed or doubled fist, as for striking. 	 6. A plough. 	 7. A fragrant kind of grass: see कत्तृण. E. खट् to seek, to wish, affix अच्.
खटक: खटक m. (-कः) 	 1. A go-between, a man whose business it is to nego-ciate marriages: see घटक. 	 2. The doubled fist of wrestlers or box-ers.  E. खट् to seek, to wish, affix वुन्.
खटकामुख: खटकामुख m. (-खः) A man in the attitude of shooting.
खटखादक: खटखादक m. (-कः) 	 1. An eater. 	 2. A glass vessel. 	 3. A jackal. 	 4. an animal. 	 5. A crow.
खटिक: खटिक m. (-कः) The fist, the hand closed. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. Chalk. 	 2. The external opening of the ear. 	 3. A fragrant grass: (Andropogon muricatus.)  E. खट् to seek or wish, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted.
खटिनी: खटिनी f. (-नी) Chalk.  E. खट् to seek, इनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also कठिनी.
खटी: खटी f. (-टी) Chalk.  E. खट् to seek, अच् and ङीष् affs.
खट्ट: खट्ट r. 10th cl. (खट्टयति) To cover, to screen.
खट्टन: खट्टन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dwarfish, short of stature.  E. खट्ट् to cover or hide, affix ल्यु.
खट्टा: खट्टा f. (-ट्टा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)  E. खट्ट् to screen, अङ् and टाप् affs.
खट्टाश: खट्टाश mf. (-शः-शी) The civet or zebet cat, (Viverra zibetha.)  E. खट्टा the grass, and अश who eats; also खट्टास.
खट्टास: खट्टास m. (-सः) The civet: see the preceding.
खट्टि: खट्टि m. (-ट्टिः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried to the pile; also खट्टी.  E. खट्ट् to screen, affix कि.
खट्टिक: खट्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hunter, a fowler, one who lives by killing and selling game. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. A small bedstead, a cot. 	 2. A bier or bed on which the corpse is carried.  E. खट्ट् to screen, इकन् aff.
खट्वा: खट्वा f. (-ट्वा) 	 1. A bedstead, a cot, a couch. 	 2. A hammock, a swing E. खट्ट् to hide, Unadi affix कन्
खट्वाङ्ग: खट्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A king of the solar line. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Part of a bed. 	 2. A. club or staff with a skull at the top of it, considered as a weapon of Siva, and carried by penitents and Yogis. 	 3. Wood from a fun-eral pile.  E. खट्वा a cot, and अङ्ग body or form.
खट्वाङ्गभृत्: खट्वाङ्गभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of SIVA.  E. खट्वाङ्ग one of his weapons, भृत् who maintains.
खट्वाङ्गिन्: खट्वाङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A name of SIVA.  E. खट्वाङ्ग, and इनि aff.
खट्वारूढ: खट्वारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 	 1. Low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous. 	 2. Erring, going wrong. 	 3. Stupid, silly. 	 4. Laid or lying on a bed.  E. खट्वा a bed, and आरूढ mounted.
खट्विका: खट्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead.  E. खट्वा a bedstead, and कन् affix. fem. form.
खड: खड r. 10th cl. (खाडयति) also (इ,) खडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (खण्डति, खण्डयति) and (इ ङ) खडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खण्डते) To divide, ‘to tear, to break off a part or piece.
खड m. (-डः) 	 1. Breaking, dividing. 	 2. Buttermilk boiled with acid vegetables and spices. 	 3. A small grass. 	 f. (-डी) Chalk.  E. खड्. to break, &c. affix अच्.
खडक्किका: खडक्किका f. (-का) A private or back door, a small venetian door or window.
खडिका: खडिका f. (-का) Chalk.  E. खड्. to break, affix वुन्, fem. form.
खडु: खडु m. (-डुः) A bier.  E. खड्. to break, affix उ.
खङ्ग: खङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros. 	 2. A rhinocero's horn. 	 3. A sword, a scymi-tar. 	 4. A large sacrificial knife. 	 5. One of the Buddhas or Baud-dha saints. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) Iron.  E. खड्. to tear or rend, Unadi affix गन.
खङ्गकोष: खङ्गकोष m. (-षः) 	 1. A creeping plant, (Scripus maximus.) 	 2. A scab-bard, a sheathe.  E. खङ्ग a sword. and कोष a sheathe.
खङ्गचर्म्मधर: खङ्गचर्म्मधर m. (-रः) A soldier armed with a sword and shield.  E. खङ्ग, and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.
खङ्गट: खङ्गट m. (-टः) A large kind of Kas, (Saccharum spontaneum.)  E. खङ्ग the rhinoceros, and अट who goes; these animals being usually found amongst high grass or reeds.
खङ्गधर: खङ्गधर m. (-रः) A swordsman.  E. खङ्ग, and धर who holds.
खङ्गधेनु: खङ्गधेनु f. (-नुः) 	 1. A small knife. 	 2. A female rhinoceros.  E. खङ्ग a sword &c. धेनु a cow, used here as a diminutive.
खङ्गपत्र: खङ्गपत्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a creeper. (Scirpus maximus.) 	 n. (-त्रं) The blade of a sword.  E. खङ्ग a sword, and पत्र leaf.
खङ्गपाणि: खङ्गपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Holding a sword.  E. खङ्ग, and पाणि the hand.
खङ्गपात्र: खङ्गपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel of buffalo's horn.  E. खङ्ग and पात्र a vessel.
खड्गपिधान: खड्गपिधान n. (-नं) A scabbard, a sheathe.  E. खड्ग a sword, and पिधान a sheathe; also with कन् added, खङ्गपिधानक.
खङ्गपुत्रिका: खङ्गपुत्रिका f. (-का) A knife, a small sword.  E. खङ्ग, and पुत्तिका infant.
खङ्गप्रहार: खङ्गप्रहार m. (-रः) A sword cut.  E. खङ्ग, and प्रहार a stroke.
खङ्गमांस: खङ्गमांस m. (-सः) Buffalo-beef.  E. खङ्ग, and मांस flesh.
खङ्गलेखा: खङ्गलेखा f. (-खा) A row of sabres. खङ्ग, and लेखा a line.
खङ्गराट: खङ्गराट m. (-टः) 	 1. A shield. One who observes a peculiar religious obli-gation, rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the edge of a sword made red hot, this is a penance peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. खङ्ग a sword, रट् to speak, deriv. irr.
खड्गाघात: खड्गाघात m. (-तः) A sword cut.  E. खड्ग, and आघात a blow.
खङ्गाधार: खङ्गाधार m. (-रः) A sheathe, a scabbard.  E. खङ्ग, and आधार what receives.
खङ्गाभिहत: खङ्गाभिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut or struck with a sword.  E. खङ्ग, and अभि-हत struck.
खङ्गामिष: खङ्गामिष n. (-षं) Buffalo's flesh.  E. खङ्ग, and आमिष flesh.
खङ्गिक: खङ्गिक m. (-कः) 	 1. The cream or froth of buffalo's milk. 	 2. A vender of flesh meat.  E. खङ्ग a sword, &c. affix ठक्.
खङ्गिन्: खङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Armed with a sword. 	 m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. A rhinoceros. 2. A Jina or Jaina saint.  E. खङ्ग a horn, &c. affix इनि.
खङ्गिमार: खङ्गिमार m. (-रः) A kind of creeper: see खङ्गकोष.  E. खङ्गि a rhinoceros, and मार what destroys.
खङ्गीक: खङ्गीक m. (-कः) A sickle, a scythe.  E. खङ्ग a scymitar, and इकन् aff.
खण्ड: खण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 	 1. A piece, a part, a fragment, a portion. 	 2. A chap-ter, a section. 	 3. A term in an equation. 	 m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A flaw in a jewel. 	 2. Treacle or molasses partially dried or candied. 	 n. (-ण्डं) 	 1. A sort of sugar cane. 	 2. Black salt.  E. खडि to break, and घञ् affix or खन् to tear, affix ड, and न changed to ण.
खण्डक: खण्डक m. (-कः) 	 1. Pared or clipped finger nails. 	 2. A part, a piece. E. खण्ड् to tear, वुन् aff.
खण्डकथा: खण्डकथा f. (-था) A tale or story divided into sections.  E. खण्ड a section, and कथा a story.
खण्डकालु: खण्डकालु n. (-लु) An esculent root, sweet potatoe: also खण्डकालुक n. (-कं) E. खण्डक a portion, and आलु any esculent root.
खण्डकाव्य: खण्डकाव्य (-व्यं) 	 n. A poem interspersed with prose.  E. खण्ड, and काव्य a poem.
खण्डज: खण्डज m. (-जः) Treacle, molasses.  E. खण्ड, and ज what is produced.
खण्डधारा: खण्डधारा f. (-रा) Shears, scissors.  E. खण्ड a part, and and धृ to have or hold, in the causal from.
खण्डन: खण्डन n. (-नं) 	 1. Breaking, dividing, cutting, reducing to pieces. 	 2. Destroying, annihilating. 	 3. Refuting, (in argument.) 	 4. Rebellion, opposition.  E. खण्ड् to break, ल्युट् aff.
खण्डनरत: खण्डनरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destructive, skilful in cutting or destroying. E. खण्डन, and रत engaged in.
खण्डनीय: खण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Brittle, fragile. 	 2. Refutable. 	 3. Destruct-ible, &c.  E. खडि, and अनीयर् affix; also खण्ड्य, and खण्डितव्य.
खण्डपत्र: खण्डपत्र n. (-त्रं) A bundle of various leaves.  E. खण्ड, and पत्र a leaf.
खण्डपरशु: खण्डपरशु m. (-शुः) A name of SIVA.  E. खण्ड a part, and परशु a hatchet; cutting his foes to pieces.
खण्डपर्शु: खण्डपर्शु m. (-र्शुः) 	 1. A name of PARASURAMA. 	 2. A name of SIVA. 	 3. Rahu, the personified ascending node. 	 4. A spreader of unguents, fragrant powders, &c. 	 5. A drug, commonly Chandamalaki. 	 6. An elephant with a broken tusk.  E. खण्ड a part, and पर्शु an axe; whose axe or arms cut every thing to pieces.
खण्डपाल: खण्डपाल m. (-लः) A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats.  E. खण्ड molasses, and पाल who cherishes.
खण्डप्रलय: खण्डप्रलय m. (-यः) Partial destruction of the universe, the destruction of the division of the terrestrial world.  E. खण्ड, and प्रलय destruc-tion.
खण्डमण्डल: खण्डमण्डल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Gibbous, not full or round. 	 n. (-लं) A segment of a circle, part of a circle or an incomplete sphere. E. खण्ड, and मण्डल sphere.
खण्डमोदक: खण्डमोदक m. (-कः) Granulated sugar.  E. खण्ड, and मोदक a sweetmeat.
खण्डलवण: खण्डलवण n. (-णं) Black salt.  E. खण्ड, and लवण salt.
खण्डशस्: खण्डशस् ind. Piece meal, in or by pieces.  E. खण्ड, and शसि aff.
खण्डसर: खण्डसर m. (-रः) Granulated sugar.  E. खण्ड, and सर what goes.
खण्डाभ्र: खण्डाभ्र n. (-भ्रं) 	 1. Scattered clouds. 	 2. A bite, the impression of the teeth.  E. खण्ड a part, and अभ्र a cloud, &c.
खण्डाली: खण्डाली f. (-ली) 	 1. A measure for oil. 	 2. A pond. 	 3. A woman whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.
खण्डिक: खण्डिक m. (-कः) 	 1. Pease. 	 2. The armpit  E. खडि to break, इकन् aff.

खल्ल: खल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 	 1. A kind of cloth or clothes, leather garments.) 	 2. A canal, a cut, a creek, a trench, a deep hole. 	 3. The Chataka, a kind of cuckoo. 	 4. Leather. 	 5. खवाष्प: खवाष्प m. (-प्पः) Snow, hoar frost, dew.  E. ख sky, and वाष्प vapour or tears.
खश: खश m. (-शः) 	 1. A mountainous country to the north of India. 	 2. A native of that country, considered as a degraded Kshetriya. 	 f. (-शा) A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.

खशेट: खशेट m. (-टः) The Khalisa, a kind of fish: see खलेश.
खश्वास: खश्वास m. (-सः) Air or wind.  E. ख the atmosphere, and श्वास breath.
खष: खष r. 1st cl. (खषति) To kill, to hurt or injure.
खष्प: खष्प n. (-ष्यं) 	 1. Anger, passion. Violence, oppression.  E. खन् to hurt, to dig, प Unadi affix, न changed to ष.
खस: खस m. (-सः) Itch, scab. 	 2. A man of a country or tribe considerd to be a degraded Kshetriya: the Khasas inhabit the mountains surroun-ding Kashmir. 	 f. (-सा) The mother of the imps or goblins.
खसगन्ध: खसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, commonly Kshirakakolic.
खसम: खसम m. (-मः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.  E. ख heaven, and सम equal, the same.
खसम्भव: खसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the sky, aerial, ethereal.  E. ख, and सम्भव birth.
खसर्पण: खसर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Buddha or Bouddha saints. 	 n. (-णं) Gliding through the air.  E. ख heaven, and सर्पण who goes to or in.

खस्तनी: खस्तनी f. (-नी) The earth.  E. ख earth, स्तन a breast, affix ङीष्.
खस्खसरस: खस्खसरस m. (-सः) Poppy juice, opium.  E. खस्खस and रस juice.
खस्फटिक: खस्फटिक m. (-कः) 	 1. Crystal, the sun gem. 	 2. The moon gem: see सूर्य्यकान्त and चन्द्रकान्त  E. ख heaven, and स्फटिक crystal.

खोल: खोल (ऋ) खोऌ r. 1st cl. (खोलति) To be lame, to limp, to be prevented from moving. खोड, खोर, &c. are conceived by some authorities to be mere variations in the form of this root.
खोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lame.  E. खोल् to be lame, affix अच्; also खोर, &c.
खोलक: खोलक m. (-कः) 	 1. A helmet, armour for the head. 	 2. A pot, a sauce-pan. 	 3. An ant-hill. 	 4. The shell of the betel nut.  E. खुड्. to cover, affix ण्वुल्, ड changed to ल.
खोल्क: खोल्क m. (-ल्कः) 	 1. A meteor. 	 2. A planet.  E. ख, and उल्का torch.
खोल्मुक: खोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet MARS.  E. ख heaven, उल्मुक a hot coal.
ख्या: ख्या r. 2nd cl. (ख्याति) 	 1. To relate, to recount, to say or tell. 	 2. To celebrate, to make known. With अभि prefixed, To shine or be glorious. With आ, To be famous. With वि, to celebrate. With सु, To be approved. With कु, To be infamous. With प्रति and आ, To reject, to refuse. With सम्, To count, to reckon. With सं and आ to denominate.
ख्यात: ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, notorious.  E. ख्या to relate, affix क्त.
ख्यातगर्हण: ख्यातगर्हण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Notoriously vile, infamous.  E. ख्यात famous, गर्हण abuse; also ख्यातगर्हित.
ख्यातगर्हित: ख्यातगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Infamous: see the preceding.
ख्याति: ख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity.  E. ख्या to tell, affix क्तिन्.
ख्यापक: ख्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Declaring, making known, one who tells or declares. 	 2. One who confesses.  E. ख्या to say, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
ख्यापन: ख्यापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Declaring, divulging. 	 2. Saying, avowing. 	 3. Confess-ing. 	 4. Explaining.  E. ख्या causal form, ल्युट् aff.
